summary: Approved. Static review and a stubbed Rerun API smoke check confirm examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py now logs only images/rgb, images/depth_meters, images/depth_meters_visualization, and non-spatial status/* telemetry. No world_normal or diffuse streams, 3D Rerun archetype logs, or spatial spear/* Rerun paths remain in the script. No blocking runtime issues were found in status logging.
work_completed: Reviewed examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py logging paths, capture component descriptors, conversion helpers, and status logging code.
Ran static searches for world_normal, diffuse, spatial spear paths, rgb_projection, camera trajectory/position, and Rerun 3D archetypes in the target script.
Installed rerun-sdk==0.32.2 into a temporary target and smoke-checked rr.Image, rr.DepthImage, rr.Scalars, and rr.TextDocument availability.
Ran a stubbed log_rerun_frame smoke check with rerun-sdk==0.32.2; it emitted exactly the three image paths and nine status paths expected.

findings.message: examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:33-41 captures only rgb and depth_meters components, removing the prior world_normal and diffuse inputs.

examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py:239-263 logs exactly images/rgb, images/depth_meters, images/depth_meters_visualization, status/camera/world_x_meters, status/camera/world_y_meters, status/camera/world_z_meters, status/camera/status, status/light/intensity, status/light/enabled, status/light/yaw_offset_degrees, status/light/pitch_offset_degrees, and status/light/status.

Static search found no remaining world_normal, diffuse, rr.Transform3D, rr.Pinhole, rr.Points3D, rr.LineStrips3D, rr.Arrows3D, ViewCoordinates, rgb_projection, camera_trajectory, camera_position, spatial, or spear/* Rerun logging references in examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py.

Live SPEAR simulator and Rerun viewer validation was not run; remaining risk is limited to simulator/viewer integration behavior outside static and stubbed API checks.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the live programmatic flashlight stream with a simulator and Rerun viewer when available to visually confirm the reduced hierarchy in the viewer.
